Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?
Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Lead Software Engineer at Coupa:
As an Engineering Manager for the Coupa Risk team, you will lead a development team responsible for our Coupa Risk application. You will play a crucial role in evolving our risk-scoring capabilities, helping your team build performant, scalable software that empowers customers to make confident compliance and risk decisions. You will balance technical leadership with team development, collaborating across product and engineering teams to integrate AI-driven risk insights and drive continuous improvement within the Coupa engineering community.

What You’ll Do
• Team Leadership & Growth: Lead, coach, and empower a cross-functional development team through problem-solving sessions. Act as a servant leader, ensuring the team understands the business context behind our risk-domain due diligence initiatives.
• Strategic Execution: Drive the development of "Coupa Risk" and lead the evolution of our risk-scoring capabilities to deliver more precise, actionable insights for our customers.
• Process & Innovation: Partner with peer engineering managers and architects to drive continuous process improvements. Lead initiatives to adopt new technologies (e.g., AI-assisted log querying, multi-skill orchestrators) that enhance triage and production reliability.
• Technical Stewardship: Oversee the adoption of Coupa’s architectural advancements. Ensure the team maintains high engineering standards (code reviews, unit testing) while delivering maintainable, scalable microservices and robust integrations.
• Collaboration: Establish trust and coordinate with product management, support, cloud operations, and other engineering teams. Work closely with Product to align the team’s roadmap with the broader "Risk Aware" vision.
• Hiring & Mentorship: Partner with the recruiting team to grow the team. Provide continuous feedback, create career action plans, and foster a culture of mentorship for both under- and high-performing team members.
• Metrics & Delivery: Track key business and technical metrics, including feature delivery speed, code quality, and security posture (e.g., Snyk findings, Pentest remediations).

What You Will Bring to Coupa
• Experience:
• 12+ years of experience building enterprise, SaaS web applications using one or more of the following modern frameworks technologies: .Net, SQL, and Typescript and strong knowledge of Javascript, CSS, HTML5.
• 5+ years of relevant technical lead or management experience. You have a proven track record of growing into management from a successful individual contributor role.
• Technical Proficiency: Strong background in web application or platform development. While deep familiarity with Ruby on Rails is a significant plus, you can understand complex technical architectures, review design work, and provide meaningful feedback across various technology stacks.
• Engineering Discipline: Commitment to best practices, including CI/CD, code reviews, and the delivery of testable code. You prioritize building frameworks that improve long-term system stability and prevent technical debt.
• Domain Insight: An interest in risk-based software solutions. You are excited by the challenge of handling complex data, regulatory compliance (e.g., DORA, GDPR), and improving customer confidence through data integrity.
• Communication: Strong listening, written, and verbal communication skills. You can translate complex functional requirements (like those for Risk-Aware dashboards) into clear technical tasks.
• Decision Making: Ability to manage priorities in a high-growth environment, set appropriate expectations with stakeholders, and deliver high-quality features on time.
• Agile Methodology: Experience with agile (Scrum) development processes and the ability to pivot as project roadmaps evolve.

About the Role

PubMatic is looking for a strategic and commercially driven Associate Director, Advertiser Solutions to help grow our buyer-side business across South Asia. This role will focus on building and scaling relationships with advertisers, agencies, trading teams, and other demand-side stakeholders, while driving adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused programmatic solutions.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the programmatic advertising ecosystem, strong understanding of buyer and DSP workflows, and a proven ability to win new business, grow strategic accounts, and influence go-to-market priorities. This role requires strong direct brand relationships in addition to agency connectivity, with the ability to engage senior marketing, media, and programmatic decision-makers and translate PubMatic’s capabilities into clear commercial value.

What You’ll Do
Drive business growth
• Own and grow revenue for PubMatic’s Advertiser Solutions business across South Asia.
• Build, manage, and convert a strong pipeline of opportunities across advertisers, agencies, trading desks, and other buy-side partners.
• Identify, prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new business opportunities.
• Expand PubMatic’s footprint with both existing and new buyers through strategic account planning and targeted growth initiatives.
• Drive adoption of PubMatic’s buyer-side solutions, including private marketplace, preferred, programmatic guaranteed, curated, and Activate-led opportunities.

Build strategic client relationships
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with brands, agency investment teams, trading desks, and programmatic leads across South Asia.
• Strengthen PubMatic’s direct access to brand-side decision-makers across digital, media, and marketing teams.
• Build senior-level relationships with strategic clients and position PubMatic as a consultative partner for premium supply access, efficiency, transparency, and performance.
• Partner closely with agencies and advertisers to uncover growth opportunities and drive long-term adoption.

Lead strategic customer engagement
• Own strategic engagements with key accounts, ensuring high-quality pre-sales support, thoughtful solutioning, and strong post-sale alignment with internal teams.
• Map customer business goals to PubMatic solutions and develop account strategies that drive measurable outcomes.
• Support renewals, account expansion, and deeper buy-side integration through proactive relationship management and opportunity development.
• Provide clear market and customer feedback to improve solution adoption and account growth.

Influence product and market strategy
• Bring actionable customer feedback, market insight, and competitive intelligence into internal product and commercial discussions.
• Help shape go-to-market strategy based on customer needs and evolving buyer dynamics.
• Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions teams to refine positioning, strengthen messaging, and improve sales readiness.
• Develop a strong understanding of PubMatic’s marketplace design, supply dynamics, and advertiser value proposition.

Represent PubMatic in market
• Build PubMatic’s visibility and credibility across the South Asia buy-side ecosystem.
• Stay current on industry trends, supply path optimization, privacy and addressability changes, and shifts in advertiser buying behavior.

What Success Looks Like
• Meets or exceeds monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for Advertiser Solutions.
• Builds a strong pipeline and converts strategic opportunities into long-term customer value.
• Expands PubMatic’s direct relationships with both brands and agencies in South Asia.
• Increases adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused solutions across key accounts.
• Contributes meaningful customer and market insight that helps shape strategy and execution.

Who You Are
Must Have
• 9–12+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, AdTech, media sales, agency partnerships, DSP, SSP, or advertiser-facing platform roles.
• Strong understanding of the buyer-side and DSP ecosystem and how advertisers and agencies buy programmatically.
• Proven success in new business development, pipeline building, and strategic account growth.
• Strong direct relationships across brands, agencies, and trading teams in South Asia.
• Experience selling or positioning programmatic advertising solutions to advertiser and agency stakeholders.
• Strong knowledge of private marketplace deals, programmatic guaranteed, supply path optimization, curation, and premium programmatic buying models.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
• Ability to translate technical and platform capabilities into compelling client value.
• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with strong ownership and accountability.

Nice to Have
• Prior experience at an SSP, DSP, agency trading desk, media platform, or advertiser technology company.
• Experience managing strategic partnerships and complex commercial negotiations.
• Familiarity with South Asia market dynamics, major holding groups, independent agencies, and key advertiser categories.
• Experience contributing to product feedback loops, go-to-market planning, or market enablement initiatives.

Additional Information:

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for an Account Executive, Majors to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Regional Director of Sales in the Sales department. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future as we cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

Solve customer pain points by leveraging Zscaler's unique value proposition and inspiring technology

Educate key decision-makers within your territory to demonstrate the power and agility of cloud transformation

Operate as the GM of your business, creating comprehensive plans for coverage, prospecting, and marketing

Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers to deliver both business and technical value to clients

Manage the full sales cycle from initial engagement to closure while building a robust customer footprint

Who You Are (Success Profile)

You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

Extensive experience in Sales with a consistent revenue quota

Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field

Proven experience engaging with accounts and selling at the C-Level

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence platforms or positioning AI-driven security architectures to accelerate complex enterprise sales cycles

Background in Security, SaaS, or Software sales with a demonstrated history of top-tier quota over-achievement

Experience collaborating with Channel partners to build joint plans and drive pipeline to closure

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
• Various health plans
• Time off plans for vacation and sick time
• Parental leave options
• Retirement options
• Education reimbursement
• In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Pay Transparency

Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER, FRONTIER ENGINEERING

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential – and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology – and careers – to the next level.

Where Data Does More. Join the Snowflake team.

At Snowflake, we are building a high-impact team to help the world's most innovative companies unlock the power of AI. As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Frontier Engineering team, you will be a hands-on builder and a key technical partner to our most strategic customers, placing you at the forefront of the enterprise AI revolution. You won't just work with cutting-edge technology – you'll deploy it to solve real-world business problems at scale, building production-grade AI systems using Snowpark, Cortex, and our native LLM capabilities.

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Build Customer Solutions: Architect, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions, including sophisticated AI agents. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of your workstreams – from prototype to production – directly solving customers' most complex business challenges.

Own the Quality of What You Ship: Define what "good" means for the systems you build. Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Treat measurement as a first-class part of building, not an afterthought.

Deliver with Velocity: Rapidly design, iterate, and ship high-quality code and pipelines. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions using Python and SQL.

Productionize AI at Scale: Own the full implementation lifecycle for your solutions – from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy, and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time.

Be a Technical Partner: Partner directly with customer data science and engineering teams as a hands-on technical resource and trusted advisor on how to best leverage AI for their business challenges.

Collaborate to Innovate: Work cross-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, sharing real-world feedback from the field to directly influence the future of Snowflake's AI platform.

Have the opportunity to travel: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
• Willingness to travel.
• Proven experience building applications using LLMs, especially with technologies like RAG and agentic workflows.
• Hands-on experience defining quality metrics and running evaluations for LLM or agent systems, and using evals to systematically improve quality.
• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing Generative AI environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience building eval sets from production traces and synthetic data, and running structured experimentation (A/B tests, ablations, offline evals) to compare prompts, models, or agent architectures.
• Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Weave, Promptfoo) or experience building custom eval harnesses.
• Experience with failure-mode analysis on agent or RAG systems – categorizing errors (hallucination, retrieval miss, planning failure, tool misuse) and driving each down with targeted evals.
• Hands-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
• Familiarity with core data science libraries and tools (e.g., pandas, numpy, Snowpark).
• Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., solutions architect, sales engineer, or professional services).
• Startup experience.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Addepar is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Engineering Manager to join our world-class team.In this high-impact role, you won't just lead a group of engineers—you'll be the driving force behind scaling the Addepar Platform and architecting cross-cutting solutions that redefine how our products interact.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

Your responsibilities will include:
• Driving the technical direction for cross cutting products across Addepar.
• Collaborating with teams from various departments to successfully implement platform strategies.
• Building and managing a team of exceptional engineers.
• Ensuring flawless and timely execution of deliverables.
• Developing and maintaining relationships with partners across Addepar.

Who You Are
• Minimum 10+ years of experience in software engineering
• Proven experience in leading engineering teams in fintech space.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
• Good experience and knowledge in the below tech stack including :

Java (Version 17 OR 21) , Kafka, Spring Boot, Quarkus, AWS , SQL/noSQL DatabasesNice to have experience with CI/CD pipelines ,terraform, docker, kubernetes, etc

Our Values
• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

• Design, build, test, deploy, maintain, and support the most accurate Document Ingestion features.
• Develop Python APIs and services using FastAPI and Pydantic.
• Build document ingestion workflows for PDFs, DOCX, and image files.
• Work with AI models, prompts, schemas, structured outputs, and OCR.
• Build asynchronous processing using S3, SQS, DynamoDB, and worker services.
• Create automated tests and extraction-quality evaluations.
• Troubleshoot production issues using logs, metrics, traces, and New Relic.
• Contribute to Docker, Terraform, Helm, and Amazon EKS deployments.
• Demonstrate autonomy and operate with minimal supervision.
• Follow best security practices for authentication, API scopes, tenant isolation, and data documentation.

Minimum Qualifications:
• 4+ years of experience building complex products.
• Proficiency in the Python programming language.
• Experience with REST APIs, background processing, databases, cloud services, and automated testing.
• Understanding of AI applications, prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, and response validation.
• Experience with monitoring and troubleshooting production systems.
• Experience using Codex/Cursor AI coding tools.
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with teams across Entrata.
• Experience with LLM APIs integrations
• Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, PyMuPDF, or AWS Textract.
• Knowledge of AWS services like S3, DynamoDB, and SQS

Preferred Qualifications:
• Knowledge of Deployment services like Docker, Terraform, Helm, or Amazon EKS.
• Experience with document-vision models and document extraction evals.
• Familiarity with JWT, API scopes, New Relic, Langfuse, Vue, or Tailwind CSS.

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?
Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of Sr Product Manager to Coupa

Coupa Expenses is a modern expense management solution that helps companies simplify employee spend, from submitting and approving expenses to reimbursing employees and gaining real-time visibility into travel and expense (T&E) activity. By having a fully integrated Mobile and Card solutions, Coupa continually delivers customer value while meeting the evolving needs of our customers.

As the primary product manager on the Coupa Expenses team, you will drive product initiatives that deliver innovation, strengthen adoption, and unblock customers. This role calls for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds trust across teams, and uses data to inform decisions. You bring a strong bias for action, deep curiosity about how our products work end-to-end, and a genuine desire to make both customers and colleagues successful.

What You’ll Do
• Lead the Expenses teams product design and requirements across complex, cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Engineering, UX, Platform, and Success teams to align on scope, dependencies, and delivery approach.
• Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give internal teams (Product, Growth, Leadership) clear visibility into product adoption, usage, and customer health.
• Act as a go-to subject matter expert for customer escalations, partnering with Support, Services, and Engineering to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
• Translate customer feedback and usage data into clear product requirements and prioritization recommendations.
• Conduct competitive market analysis and continually assess the product's competitive position domestically and internationally.
• Support and help scale internal and external enablement (webinars, documentation, training) so Support, Services, and Customer Success teams can operate more self-sufficiently.
• Represent the product in customer-facing settings, including advisory boards, escalation calls, and adoption reviews.

What You Will Bring to Coupa
• 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments with a proven track record of building buyer-facing products and consumer-grade UX
• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through to delivery, coordinating effectively across Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.
• Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building or using dashboards/reporting tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) to drive product and business decisions.
• A track record of resolving complex customer issues and turning escalations into durable product or process improvements.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.
• A collaborative, "roll up your sleeves" mindset paired with sound judgment on when to lead and when to support.
• Comfort operating with incomplete information and adapting quickly as priorities shift.

Preferred Skills:
• Experience in Expense Management, Corporate Cards, or related Finance/Procurement domains.
• Familiarity with SQL and comfort querying data directly to answer product questions.
• Experience working with or presenting to customer advisory boards or executive audiences.
• Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or PeopleSoft.
• BA/BS technical degree preferred; MBA is a plus, or equivalent work experience.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced individual contributor to architect and build scalable ML infrastructure, platforms, and engineering capabilities at PubMatic. The ML Platform team accelerates the journey from ML idea to production by reducing engineering effort, optimizing compute, and enabling reliable, repeatable model development and deployment. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on architecture, complex engineering challenges, reusable platform capabilities, and cross-team influence; it has no direct people-management responsibility.

What You'll Do
• Architect and build scalable ML platforms, establishing technical standards and driving end-to-end design and implementation.
• Design and optimize Kubernetes-based training infrastructure, shared compute clusters, workload scheduling, and resource utilization.
• Improve model training and data-processing performance using parallelization, distributed computing, efficient data frameworks, and accelerated computing.
• Build MLOps capabilities covering experiment tracking, model versioning, hyperparameter tuning, model registries, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
• Develop reusable feature engineering components and self-service workflows that shorten experimentation and productionization cycles.
• Engineer automated model validation, regression testing, QA frameworks, drift detection, and production reliability mechanisms.
• Enable cloud-ready training pipelines and hybrid-cloud execution with performance, scalability, and cost efficiency in mind.
• Advance observability and intelligent automation, including automated RCA, knowledge graphs, and AI-assisted operational workflows.
• Evaluate emerging ML/AI tools, frameworks, and infrastructure technologies; turn promising approaches into production-grade solutions.
• Partner with ML, Data Science, Core Platform, and Product Engineering teams; mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance.

We'd Love for You to Have
• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record as a senior individual contributor delivering complex platforms or distributed systems.
• Advanced Python skills and strong software design, debugging, and performance-engineering fundamentals.
• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, infrastructure automation, and production operations.
• Experience designing large-scale distributed systems, data-processing platforms, or ML training infrastructure.
• Strong understanding of MLOps, ML training pipelines, model deployment, lifecycle automation, and CI/CD.
• Experience with Apache Spark, Hadoop, or comparable distributed data-processing technologies.
• Ability to make architecture trade-offs, independently lead complex technical initiatives, and influence teams without direct authority.

Good to Have:
• Experience building internal ML platforms used by multiple engineering or data science teams.
• Familiarity with LightGBM, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Weights & Biases, or MLflow.
• Experience with GPU computing, CUDA, NVIDIA Triton, or optimized model-serving systems.
• Experience with AWS, hybrid-cloud infrastructure, feature stores, model registries, and automated retraining.
• Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, and knowledge graphs.
• Experience in AdTech, real-time bidding, or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive environments.

AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset:

We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.

Additional Information:

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Your role as a Business Intelligence Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.

• Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
• Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
• Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
• Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
• Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
• Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
• Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
• Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
• Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.

• Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
• Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
• Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
• Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
• Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

We'd Love for You to Have
• Shift Timings - 2.00 PM to 11 PM
• Proven 4 to 6 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
• Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
• Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
• Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
• Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
• Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
• Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
• Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.

Qualifications:

Job Description
Experian India helps lenders, fintechs and enterprises make better decisions through data, analytics, decisioning, fraud and identity solutions, and helps millions of Indians understand and improve their credit health.

The Marketing Director is a high-profile and influential role, important to our next phase of growth in India. You will lead the end-to-end marketing agenda: building the brand, taking products to market, driving pipeline and consumer growth, and shaping how the industry sees us.

This is not a conventional communications role. It is a commercially accountable, full-funnel leadership role for a hands-on leader who combines strategic clarity with thoughtful prioritisation

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
• Shape a trusted brand in one of the world's fastest-growing credit and digital-finance markets.
• Lead B2B and consumer marketing under one remit, a breadth of scope few marketing roles offer.
• Make a direct, visible impact on business performance, working closely with the Managing Director and business leaders.
• Turn complex data, credit and analytics topics into stories that matter to businesses, regulators and consumers.
• Build and lead your own marketing function, with real ownership and room to grow as a marketing leader.

WORK THAT MATTERS – WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Marketing strategy and leadership
• Define and lead the annual and multi-year marketing strategy, aligned to business priorities.
• Translate business objectives into one integrated plan across B2B, consumer, digital, communications and events, with clear priorities, investment choices and KPIs.

Brand, market positioning and partnerships
• Position the brand as the clear market leader in its sector across corporate, B2B and consumer audiences, through owned, earned and paid channels.
• Build recognition beyond the traditional credit bureau identity, as a data, analytics and technology partner.
• Build brand and customer experiences with ecosystem partners, extending the brand through co-marketing and strategic collaborations.

Brand marketing, product marketing and go-to-market
• Develop brand value propositions, messaging and positioning across credit, analytics, decisioning, fraud and identity product lines.
• Deliver integrated go-to-market campaigns for new products, with Product and Sales teams.
• Work closely with Sales to build a scalable, end-to-end lead-generation process, account-based and vertical campaigns, and nurture programmes that drive pipeline and customer advocacy.
• Create client-facing content and sales enablement, including brochures, case studies, reference programmes and sales training.

Digital marketing and growth
• Lead a digital-first marketing strategy covering websites, social media, online campaigns and digital communications such as newsletters and blogs.
• Increase traffic, usability, lead capture and engagement, using CRM and marketing-automation tools to measure and optimise performance.

PR, communications and reputation
• Define the PR strategy and lead media relations, executive visibility and leadership positioning across business, financial, technology and mainstream media.
• Own issues and crisis communications, protecting trust and reputation in a highly regulated, data-intensive environment.
• Partner on internal communications so colleagues feel informed and connected to the strategy.

Thought leadership, industry engagement and events
• Build data-led thought-leadership platforms, such as reports, whitepapers and market insights, that turn proprietary data into credible industry narratives.
• Strengthen relationships with industry bodies, associations, regulators and financial institutions across the credit and financial-services ecosystem.
• Own the event and conference calendar and end-to-end delivery, aligning sales and marketing on objectives, and evaluate results to improve continuously.

Agencies, budget and team
• Own and optimise the marketing budget against commercial outcomes, making every rupee work hard.
• Select and manage PR, digital, creative, media and event agencies against clear scopes and performance standards.
• Lead, coach and grow a high-performing marketing team, working across Sales, Product, Technology, Legal and Compliance, Risk and Finance.

Qualifications
WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BRING TO THE ROLE
• 14–16 years of marketing experience, including senior leadership of marketing teams.
• A genuine blend of B2B and B2C/D2C marketing, ideally in organisations that run both models, such as fintech, payments, BFSI, information services or technology.
• A strong track record in B2B product marketing, go-to-market and lead generation for data, technology or financial products.
• Experience building brand through partnerships, events and ecosystem collaborations.
• Thoughtful prioritisation and efficient use of marketing investment.
• Strong digital marketing grounding, including social, CRM and marketing-automation tools.
• Experience managing PR and marketing agencies, budgets and suppliers.

Great to have
• Experience in credit information, lending or BFSI, including responsible consumer communication.
• Established relationships with industry bodies, media and agencies in India.
• Experience in issues and crisis communications in a regulated environment.
• MBA or a professional qualification in marketing.

Additional Information
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build and operate the data pipelines and models that power internal decision-making on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will work alongside senior engineers, learn our platform from the inside as customer zero, and grow your ownership of production data products over time.

AS A DATA ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:
• Build and maintain production data pipelines and models on Snowflake, from ingestion through transformation and consumption
• Develop dbt models with tests and documentation that follow team standards and governance practices
• Build and support Apache Airflow DAGs that orchestrate Snowflake workloads reliably
• Ingest data from enterprise sources using Snowpipe, Snowpark, and dynamic tables
• Apply data quality checks and help monitor Snowflake warehouse cost and performance
• Act as an internal customer zero, sharing feedback on Snowflake features with Product teams
• Take part in Agile ceremonies including stand ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
• Partner with stakeholders and senior engineers to turn well-defined requirements into scoped technical tasks

OUR IDEAL DATA ENGINEER WILL HAVE:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• 3+ years of hands-on experience building data pipelines or data models in a production environment
• Strong SQL and working Python skills, including basic query tuning and schema design
• Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake
• Working knowledge of dbt and an orchestration tool such as Apache Airflow
• Understanding of dimensional modelling concepts
• Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative, curious approach to learning
• Ownership mindset: you follow problems through to resolution and ask for help when needed

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:
• Exposure to Snowflake Cortex AI functions or other LLM APIs for data enrichment
• Experience preparing data for ML model training or feature engineering
• Familiarity with streaming ingestion such as Kafka or Snowpipe Streaming
• Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including infrastructure-as-code
